jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:

As Customer Success Manager at Peppy, you will play a pivotal role in nurturing and expanding our relationships with both mid-market and enterprise Fortune 500 clients and senior executives. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Success, you will become an indispensable advisor, providing strategic insights and ensuring our clients derive maximum value from our services.

Who is Peppy?

Peppy exists to make expert-led healthcare simple, human and stigma-free. Because everyone deserves support that is life changing.
Our mission is to fix healthcare & wellbeing. We do this by supporting the employees of our global clients, including JP Morgan, Disney, Meta, Nvidia, Microsoft, Sony, Clifford Chance, Wells Fargo, Bloomberg, and over 200 others.
We are a Series B company with $56m in funding to date, operationally cashflow positive, and with secure access to additional capital for accelerated growth. Join us for the ride of your life.

Life as a Customer Success Manager at Peppy:

Outcome Alchemist: Sprinkle the “Peppy magic” into every client touchpoint - consistently delivering high GRR & NRR metrics across your book of business
Relationship Maestro: Master the post-sale process, orchestrating implementations like a pro and strategising comms plans that maximise user adoption
Peppy's VIP Whisperer: Be the day-to-day contact for your client book of business, answering queries at the speed of Peppy
Value Visionary: Craft and convey Peppy's value story, ensure stakeholders don't just see Peppy; they perceive Peppy’s high value impact on their organisation
Feedback Virtuoso: Manage client feedback like a pro, ensuring it lands in the right hands internally. It's not just feedback; it's the secret sauce for Peppy's continuous evolution.
Automation architect: build and optimise automated processes and workflows to scale support efficiently, improve consistency and reduce manual effort

Our dream Customer Success Manager:

Proven Success: Demonstrated 1-2 years in client facing role, highlighting a track record of achievements
Communication Master: Fluent in both written and spoken communication, especially in client interactions.
Resourceful Navigator: Adaptable and resourceful, excelling in the startup environment.
Thoughtful Analyst: Critical thinker adept at weaving meaningful narrative that demonstrates Peppy’s value & provides practical recommendations for next steps
Adaptability Ace: Thriving in dynamic startup vibes, you're relentlessly resourceful and hungry for growth. If you're eager to learn and broaden your skill horizons, Peppy's the place for you!

Access to Peppy: You can receive free unlimited access to the Peppy app to use our Menopause, Fertility, Baby, Women’s Health or Men’s Health services.

Socials: We encourage our employees to join our in-person team events and socials to build stronger connections within your team.
Tech: New joiners receive a company MacBook delivered in time for your first day.

Peppy's mission is to help people in life's most challenging journeys. We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure that all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

Prepare operational analyses of services, projects, or general business actions

Monitor and analyze reports to identify operational issues throughout departments
Utilize systems and software to develop and maintain reporting tools to support business decisions

1 years of experience in comprehensive supply chain or logistics
Expertise in preparing, importing, and manipulating information in spreadsheets, databases, and presentations
Experience with Microsoft Office; ability to extract system data from SAP and utilize Excel/Access to develop reports
Advanced Excel skills, including macros
Experience with converting raw data into usable formats
Support experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), order management applications and database systems

Availability to travel up to 10% of the time
Strong problem-solving techniques, statistical analysis skills and the ability to create queries, solid data mining and development skills
Ability to create solutions-based reports to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction
Fundamental comprehension of warehouse operations and supply chain structure
Strong verbal and written communication, organizational and time management skills

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With

As a modern technology company, our Slalom Technologists are disrupting the market and bringing to life the art of the possible for our clients. We have passion for building strategies, solutions, and creative products to help our clients solve their most complex and interesting business problems. We surround our technologists with interesting challenges, innovative minds, and emerging technologies.  
Are you innately curious? Have a bias for action? Value connection? Want to have fun and be your authentic self at work? We want to hear from you! We’re looking for collaborative, entrepreneurial teammates who want to pursue their supply chain passion to build and shape a better future for our clients.

Our Global Supply Chain practice is a diverse team of innovators, experts, and technologists who create a lasting impact for our clients by transforming their supply chains. We have a passion for helping our clients solve their most complex and interesting supply chain problems with simple, effective solutions. We combine entrepreneurial energy, creativity and a practical approach - that focuses on real client needs and pain points - to realize business value quickly. 

What You’ll Do

Deliver projects for supply chain organizations across industry sectors.
Support, guide and manage initiatives related to IBP (Integrated Business Planning) and S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning)
Partner with clients to innovate and transform their current business models and customer experiences using advanced analytics and emerging technologies.
Use interviews, workshops and insights from data to diagnose and solve the real problems impacting operating margin and deliver business value quickly.
Execute across disciplines - analytics, technology, process and op model design – to create holistic solutions.
Work independently, as a team member, or as a mentor of other consultants and/or clients to ensure successful project delivery.
Build client knowledge, credibility and long-term trusting relationships quickly at all levels.

What You’ll Bring

Prior Consulting Background is highly preferred for Senior Consultant+ levels
IBP (Integrated Business Planning) and S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning) required

Proficiency with MS PowerPoint and Excel required; Tableau (or similar BI tool), SQL, Python or R a plus.
Experience with supply chain systems (TMS, WMS, OMS, ERP, etc.), agile development and change management are a plus.
Track record of building and delivering presentations that clearly and simply communicate complex ideas, quantitative insights and recommendations to senior executives.

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.

And for Boston, LA, White Plains, New Jersey, New York City, Seattle, San Diego, Orange County, and Washington DC the range is $94,000 to $135,000. And for all other locations the range is $86,000 to $120,000.

In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus .  Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.

jobs.description:
Johnson Controls
, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years
, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team!

Who We Are

Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. Our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places, and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

Thermal constraints limit AI infrastructure, semiconductor equipment, power electronics, and defense systems. JCI removes those constraints. Enabled by the Stack Forging™ process, JCI produces high-performance thermal components and cooling loop solutions — purpose-built for direct integration into AI, HPC, and mission-critical systems. JCI has built the industry's leading thermal management platform for the applications that demand it most.

As a Builder on the Stack Forging Thermal Solutions team at Johnson Controls, you'll join a team of sleeve-rollers who set a high bar for themselves and their co-workers. We foster a collaborative culture with no silos, where everyone is encouraged to think out loud. If you are passionate about your craft and don't give up until you've found a way, you will make an ideal Builder!

What We Offer

Competitive salary
Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
Comprehensive benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, and vision care.
On-the-job/cross-training opportunities
Encouraging and collaborative team environment
Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What You’ll Do

As a Production Planning Analyst
at JCI, you will be the analytical backbone of the Planning & Analysis team. Reporting to the Commercial Operations Manager
, you will build and run the models needed to allocate production capacity against customer demand and scale our facilities. You will translate data from across our operations into the insight and performance metrics that show how we are performing and where we can improve. You will also help design and build the cross-functional processes and systems that connect our commercial and production teams as we scale our operations.

Who You Are

You are analytical first, with a strong instinct for how to use data in a production environment. You are equally at home digging into a complex model, developing a process where none exists today, and improving one that already does. You take ownership of your work, surface issues and opportunities proactively, and are comfortable operating independently across multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities are subject to change based on shifting business needs
Resource & Capacity Planning (SIOP): Run the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning process end to end. Build and maintain the models we use to plan the scale up of our facilities and allocate production capacity against customer orders.
Production Operations Analysis: Develop a deep working understanding of our production operations and use it to build, track, and report KPIs that measure and drive the performance of the facility. Turn operational and production data into insights that help the business make better decisions.
Cost Estimating & Financial Analysis: Build and improve tools for part cost estimation and pricing analysis. Support other ad-hoc financial analysis requests as needed.
Cross-Functional Process Development & Improvement: Help design, build, and maintain the processes and systems that connect our business and production teams as we scale. Rapidly prototype lightweight tools to meet immediate needs, then formalize proven workflows into scalable, maintainable systems, identifying and closing gaps along the way.

Qualifications

Education: A Bachelor's degree in operations, industrial engineering, engineering, supply chain, finance, or a related analytical discipline.
Experience: 2–5 years in a manufacturing or production operations environment, with direct involvement in areas such as capacity or production planning, manufacturing analytics, or cost analysis.
Data & Analytics: Strong data and analytical skills, including the ability to build and run complex models and to work fluently with operational and financial data in a manufacturing context.
Programming: Basic coding experience (SQL and/or Python preferred), or a demonstrated ability to pick up programming tools quickly.
Process Development: Demonstrated ability to build, improve, and document processes, tools, or systems, especially in environments where they are still being defined.
Communication: Clear and concise in surfacing operational issues and reporting findings to both technical teammates and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Adaptability: Ability to manage shifting priorities and wear multiple hats as business needs evolve in a fast-growing environment.
AI Tools: Familiarity with leveraging AI tools or lightweight automation to improve productivity and processes.
Financial Experience: Comfortable working with financial concepts such as part costing, margin, and capex/opex budgets. Formal finance experience is a plus but not required.

jobs.title: AATC F-16 Mission Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

MTSI is seeking a highly motivated Mission Planner to support fast‑paced flight test operations for the Air National Guard Air Force Reserve Command Test Center (AATC) in Tucson, Arizona. This technical professional will assist mission planning efforts for F-16 flight test programs while serving as technical support for F-16 flight test to manage flight test data. AATC drives rapid modernization across a portfolio of combat systems, and this role provides hands‑on technical leadership throughout the mission planning lifecycle. The Mission Planning Analsyst will collaborate with the AATC government mission planning team and test directors to coordinate and execute complex F‑16 flight test missions spanning air‑to‑air and air-to ground weapons, data links, and emerging capabilities, ensuring safe, effective, and operationally relevant test events that advance the F‑16’s combat readiness.

Duties Will Include But Are Not Limited To

Report mission planning status, operational activities, and outcomes to government leadership.
Provide technical and planning support for F‑16 flight test missions.
Apply expertise in F‑16 mission planning systems, including the Joint Mission Planning System (JMPS) and Portable Flight Planning Software (PFPS), and provide user‑focused input for software updates.

jobs.description:
About The Team

The Follow Up Boss Implementation Consultant (iCon) team is a high-impact, customer-facing technical team within Zillow Group — one of the most recognized names in real estate technology. We're the team that turns new customers into confident, successful FUB power users, and our work directly shapes how thousands of real estate professionals run their businesses every day.

This is a team for people who love the craft of implementation — who get satisfaction from taking a complex, messy customer situation and turning it into a clean, scalable solution. We sit at the crossroads of product, technology, and customer success, which means no two days look the same and there's always something new to solve.

We're a collaborative, customer-first team that operates with a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Support, Enablement and Product — building strong cross-functional relationships and contributing to how we deliver for customers at scale.

If you're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, loves building relationships, and wants to do technically interesting work that has a direct, visible impact on customers — this is the role for you.

About The Role

As an Implementation Consultant, you are the bridge between new customers and long-term success with our CRM platform. You guide clients through the transition from their legacy systems to FUB, including system configuration, data migration, and integration configurations (including leveraging our open API), and deliver admin systems training to ensure each implementation is smooth, tailored, and sets customers up for lasting success. You utilize deep systems expertise to ensure seamless transitions that incorporate client business processes into clear technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

System Configuration & Implementation

Lead the customer through the end-to-end implementation process from kickoff to admin systems training, managing timelines, deliverables, risks, and all customer-facing communication.
Configure the platform to meet customer workflows, configuring and customizing Follow Up Boss to align with client business needs, workflows, team structure, and industry-specific requirements, including workflows, permissions, lead flows, inboxes, and phone numbers.
Manage implementation timelines and milestones, including managing integrations and data by facilitating data migrations, imports, and exports, and supporting integrations with the customer’s third-party tech stack (e.g., IDX systems, Zillow, transaction management products, lead sources, etc.).
Manage integrations and data by facilitating data migrations, imports, and exports, and supporting integrations with the customer’s third-party tech stack (e.g., IDX systems, Zillow, transaction management products, lead sources, etc.).
Triage and resolve issues during implementation, diagnosing common technical issues, escalating when needed with full context, and coordinating with Support or Engineering as appropriate.
Gather and document client goals and feedback, connecting them to implementation work and translating learnings into actionable insights for product and process improvements.
Provide clear handoffs to the Customer Success Manager and Sales Rep, including status, configuration decisions, open risks, and next steps for ongoing success.

Customer Enablement

Deliver admin-level training sessions, training admin-level users and power users on initial setup, system features, and best practices, ensuring customers understand how implementation work ladders up to their goals and long-term value from Follow Up Boss.
Create implementation documentation and onboarding resources, including mapping out system workflows, documenting how all systems and integrations connect to Follow Up Boss and building resources that support ongoing management of those integrations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Act as the bridge between Sales, Product, and Customer Success
Share product feedback and implementation insights with internal teams
Help refine demo strategies and implementation playbooks
Collaborate internally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Support to ensure seamless handoffs, clear documentation, and effective feedback loops across the customer lifecycle.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $31.10 - $49.70 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $29.60 - $47.20 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

3+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical account management, or consulting, ideally in CRM or customer-facing platforms.
Strong knowledge of CRM systems, such as Follow Up Boss, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar tools, and how customers use them to run their businesses.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent client projects, maintain clear timelines, and communicate status and risks effectively.
Comfort with technical concepts like APIs, integrations, data imports/exports, data mapping, and basic data cleanup (e.g., CSV/Excel).
Strong communication and presentation skills, able to translate technical concepts into clear, relatable language for non-technical users and executive stakeholders.
Customer-first mindset, with empathy, patience, problem-solving skills, and calm, confident, non-defensive communication—even in escalated situations.
Bonus: Familiarity with Zapier, real estate tech platforms (e.g., YLOPO, IDX websites, Zillow), and other common real estate integrations.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team!

Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. Our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places, and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. If you are passionate about your craft and don't give up until you've found a way, you will make an ideal Builder!

Competitive salary
Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
Comprehensive benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, and vision care.
On-the-job/cross-training opportunities
Encouraging and collaborative team environment
Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What You’ll Do

As a Production Planning Analyst
at JCI, you will be the analytical backbone of the Planning & Analysis team. Reporting to the Commercial Operations Manager
, you will build and run the models needed to allocate production capacity against customer demand and scale our facilities. You will translate data from across our operations into the insight and performance metrics that show how we are performing and where we can improve. You will also help design and build the cross-functional processes and systems that connect our commercial and production teams as we scale our operations.

Who You Are

You are analytical first, with a strong instinct for how to use data in a production environment. You are equally at home digging into a complex model, developing a process where none exists today, and improving one that already does. You take ownership of your work, surface issues and opportunities proactively, and are comfortable operating independently across multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities are subject to change based on shifting business needs
Resource & Capacity Planning (SIOP): Run the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning process end to end. Build and maintain the models we use to plan the scale up of our facilities and allocate production capacity against customer orders.
Production Operations Analysis: Develop a deep working understanding of our production operations and use it to build, track, and report KPIs that measure and drive the performance of the facility. Turn operational and production data into insights that help the business make better decisions.
Cost Estimating & Financial Analysis: Build and improve tools for part cost estimation and pricing analysis. Support other ad-hoc financial analysis requests as needed.
Cross-Functional Process Development & Improvement: Help design, build, and maintain the processes and systems that connect our business and production teams as we scale. Rapidly prototype lightweight tools to meet immediate needs, then formalize proven workflows into scalable, maintainable systems, identifying and closing gaps along the way.

Qualifications

Education: A Bachelor's degree in operations, industrial engineering, engineering, supply chain, finance, or a related analytical discipline.
Experience: 2–5 years in a manufacturing or production operations environment, with direct involvement in areas such as capacity or production planning, manufacturing analytics, or cost analysis.
Data & Analytics: Strong data and analytical skills, including the ability to build and run complex models and to work fluently with operational and financial data in a manufacturing context.
Programming: Basic coding experience (SQL and/or Python preferred), or a demonstrated ability to pick up programming tools quickly.
Process Development: Demonstrated ability to build, improve, and document processes, tools, or systems, especially in environments where they are still being defined.
Communication: Clear and concise in surfacing operational issues and reporting findings to both technical teammates and business stakeholders.

Adaptability: Ability to manage shifting priorities and wear multiple hats as business needs evolve in a fast-growing environment.
AI Tools: Familiarity with leveraging AI tools or lightweight automation to improve productivity and processes.
Financial Experience: Comfortable working with financial concepts such as part costing, margin, and capex/opex budgets. Formal finance experience is a plus but not required.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

MTSI is seeking a highly motivated Mission Planner to support fast‑paced flight test operations for the Air National Guard Air Force Reserve Command Test Center (AATC) in Tucson, Arizona. This technical professional will assist mission planning efforts for F-16 flight test programs while serving as technical support for F-16 flight test to manage flight test data. AATC drives rapid modernization across a portfolio of combat systems, and this role provides hands‑on technical leadership throughout the mission planning lifecycle. The Mission Planning Analsyst will collaborate with the AATC government mission planning team and test directors to coordinate and execute complex F‑16 flight test missions spanning air‑to‑air and air-to ground weapons, data links, and emerging capabilities, ensuring safe, effective, and operationally relevant test events that advance the F‑16’s combat readiness.

Duties Will Include But Are Not Limited To

Report mission planning status, operational activities, and outcomes to government leadership.
Provide technical and planning support for F‑16 flight test missions.
Apply expertise in F‑16 mission planning systems, including the Joint Mission Planning System (JMPS) and Portable Flight Planning Software (PFPS), and provide user‑focused input for software updates.
Support AATC mission planning independently during home‑station operations and travel, including deployments for flight test events.
Implement software and hardware updates to mission planning systems on F-16 aircraft and coordinate synchronization with program offices and AATC stakeholders.
Download, archive, and manage post‑flight mission data; ensure availability for review and oversee mission data transfer to the 309th Software Engineering Group and system vendors.
Perform data management and analysis to support F‑16 flight test solution development.
Use data tracking and analytical tools, including Microsoft Office, to support mission planning tasks.
Coordinate test mission data and recording requirements across variable F‑16 flight schedules, including early‑morning and late‑evening events.
Maintain a strong understanding of ANG/AFRC aircraft operations and tactical employment to inform mission planning improvements.
Support AATC in the end‑to‑end development of advanced combat systems within an independent, high‑energy environment alongside multidisciplinary teams of engineers, analysts, pilots, and aircrew.

Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of software testing, analysis, or practical engineering experience
Exerpience with common design tools and data analysis tools
Strong analytical skills and ability to multitask
Ability to work in a high noise environment such as nearby aircraft
Demonstrated team leadership and customer interface skills
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
Proficiency with productivity tools such as Microsoft Office
Valid driver’s license with insurable driving record
Motivated, self‑driven, and comfortable in high‑energy independent work environment

Desired Skills

Experience in military software testing, engineering, or flight test
Background in aircraft mission planning systems to include the Joint Mission Planning System (JMPS)
Experience with Special Access Programs
Knowledge of Aircraft Ethernet Bus and MIL‑STD‑1553

Education Requirements

B.S. in engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline desired

Clearance Requirements

Current Secret Clearance
Eligible for Top Secret/SCI
Current TS/SCI highly desired

Travel Requirements

Travel is expected approximately every month with periodic, mostly intraweek trips to support AATC projects. Up to 20% travel, depending on program workload and project location.
